An antigravity agent signed in with a Gemini API key (`modelProvider: "gemini"` plus `GEMINI_API_KEY`) now has a transcript. agy never invokes its `PreInvocation` hook in that mode, so the capture hook that names the conversations to stream never fires; the `statusLine` command, which agy still invokes on every state change, now records the root conversation id into the same `antigravity_conversation_ids` set. `mngr transcript` and every reader of that file see the root conversation in either sign-in mode; subagent ids still come from the hook alone.
